summary: Fix split snapshot finalization and release completion-marker contracts
details: After verifying both split artifacts, preserve a matching legacy single-file attestation in a content-addressed backup and atomically write the v2 marker.
Reject unknown or conflicting markers with actionable errors, and resume safely after the legacy backup was written.
Repeated finalization still verifies artifact hashes and signatures while preserving an identical existing attestation across wrapper revisions.
The release publisher now validates completion marker version 2, matching the Rust core and registry artifact writer; tests guard the cross-language version contract.
operator_actions: Retry mainnet_exact_height_snapshot.sh finalize for the same height and block hash after updating the script; completed snapshot databases do not need to be rebuilt.
